synopsis: Chapter 8 lists the Caterpillar D11 crawler dozer at about 106,614 kg operating weight, based on manufacturer specifications [f5963]. The glossary rounds this to about 107 t, consistent with the chapter’s figure [f11372, f11431, f5963]. These figures describe specified mass, not measured machine performance, so they should not be treated as braking-performance evidence [f5964].

relations.note: The glossary rounds the manufacturer-specified operating weight to about 107 tonnes.
Both quote the D11 mass, with different rounding.
Both glossary facts give approximately 107 tonnes.
Clarifies that the manufacturer mass figure is a specification, not a performance measurement.
